SELECT i.* FROM wms_inventory i
INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id
AND i.erp_tenant_id = #{qo.erpTenantId}
AND i.warehouse_id = #{qo.warehouseId}
AND i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.skuCode}, '%')
AND i.warehouse_id IN (SELECT id FROM wms_warehouse WHERE region_id = #{qo.regionId})
AND w.warehouse_type = #{qo.warehouseType}
AND i.damaged_quantity > 0
AND (i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity + i.in_transit_quantity + i.damaged_quantity) > 0
AND i.available_quantity = 0 AND i.reserved_quantity = 0 AND i.in_transit_quantity = 0 AND i.damaged_quantity = 0
AND i.available_quantity < 0
ORDER BY i.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_code) AS totalSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.available_quantity), 0) AS availableQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.reserved_quantity), 0) AS reservedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.in_transit_quantity), 0) AS inTransitQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.damaged_quantity), 0) AS damagedQuantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_warehouse WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS warehouseCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN s.package_length IS NOT NULL AND s.package_width IS NOT NULL AND s.package_height IS NOT NULL AND s.package_length > 0 AND s.package_width > 0 AND s.package_height > 0 THEN s.package_length * s.package_width * s.package_height * POWER( CASE COALESCE(UPPER(s.package_unit), 'M') WHEN 'CM' THEN 0.01 WHEN 'MM' THEN 0.001 ELSE 1 END, 3) * (i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity) ELSE 0 END ), 0), 2) AS totalVolume, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i2.sku_code) FROM wms_inventory i2 LEFT JOIN sku s2 ON i2.sku_code = s2.sku_code WHERE i2.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} AND (s2.package_length IS NULL OR s2.package_width IS NULL OR s2.package_height IS NULL OR s2.package_length <= 0 OR s2.package_width <= 0 OR s2.package_height <= 0) ) AS volumeMissingSkuCount FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN sku s ON i.sku_code = s.sku_code WHERE i.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId}

SELECT i.sku_code AS skuCode, COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_id) AS warehouseCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.available_quantity), 0) AS availableQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.reserved_quantity), 0) AS reservedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.in_transit_quantity), 0) AS inTransitQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.damaged_quantity), 0) AS damagedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.warehouse_type = 'FBO' THEN i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fboWarehouseQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' THEN i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ownWarehouseQuantity FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id
AND i.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId}
AND i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY i.sku_code
HAVING (SUM(i.available_quantity) + SUM(i.reserved_quantity) + SUM(i.in_transit_quantity)) > 0
HAVING (SUM(i.available_quantity) + SUM(i.reserved_quantity) + SUM(i.in_transit_quantity)) = 0
HAVING SUM(i.available_quantity) < 0
ORDER BY availableQuantity DESC

SELECT i.sku_code AS skuCode, i.available_quantity AS availableQuantity FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN sku s ON i.sku_code = s.sku_code
i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND i.available_quantity > 0
AND (i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.chinese_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY i.sku_code ASC
